description:
Hello, let’s meet!

 

 

Xebia is a global AI-first, digital transformation, and engineering partner. With over 25 years of experience and a team of 5,000 professionals across 16 countries, we help organizations design and build scalable products, platforms, and data-driven solutions. 

We specialize in Artificial Intelligence, Data and Cloud, Intelligent Automation, and Digital Products, combining deep technical expertise with a strong focus on engineering excellence and a people-first culture.  

In the CEE region, we’re a team of nearly 1,000 experts delivering modern applications, data platforms, and AI solutions for clients such as Millennium, ING, Play, Edenred, Arabian Drilling, FedEx, Leroy Merlin, Truecaller, Volotea, Schmitz Cargobull, and many, many more.

 

 

You will be:

  • automating and maintaining Linux-based environments and deployment processes,
  • supporting the delivery of product builds across development, testing, and release environments,
  • managing and improving build pipelines and software delivery processes,
  • configuring and maintaining infrastructure across virtualized and air-gapped environments,
  • troubleshooting and resolving issues across Linux systems and deployed applications,
  • supporting the configuration and operation of applications in Linux environments,
  • managing product-level configuration and release processes,
  • maintaining work tracking and technical documentation to ensure effective delivery and traceability.

 

Your profile:

  • have hands-on experience working with Linux systems in a DevOps, Infrastructure, or similar role,
  • practical experience using AI-powered assistants (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to improve productivity, quality, or decision-making in software delivery,
  • have good practical knowledge of Bash scripting,
  • have experience with Git and build/deployment pipelines,
  • have experience working with Linux in air-gapped or restricted environments,
  • understand Linux system configuration and can independently investigate and configure different operating system components,
  • have experience with virtual machines and virtual networking in a hypervisor environment,
  • understand how to run and troubleshoot Java applications in a Linux environment,
  • have a good understanding of core programming concepts, including conditionals, loops, data types, data structures, algorithms, logic, and regular expressions,
  • have basic Python programming and scripting knowledge or a strong foundation in general programming concepts,
  • have familiarity with Ansible fundamentals and configuration automation,
  • have experience with automated installation and system configuration processes,
  • understand build, release, and deployment processes,
  • have good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills,
  • are comfortable managing work items and maintaining technical and release documentation,
  • have a proactive approach to learning new technologies and understanding complex technical components,
  • good English communication skills (at least B2 level).

 

Work from the European Union region and a work permit are required.

 

 

Recruitment Process:

CV review – HR call – Interview – Client Interview – Decision
